## Categories

- [Agency Finance & Margin Ops](https://cheresonanz-design.github.io/opskanon-directory/categories/agency-finance-pricing/) (5 tools): Pricing calculators, retainer profitability trackers, multi-currency cashflow & invoicing toolkits for agencies and consultants.
- [EU Compliance & AI Governance](https://cheresonanz-design.github.io/opskanon-directory/categories/eu-compliance-governance/) (6 tools): Checklists, policy playbooks and audit readiness tooling for EU AI Act, NIS2, DORA, GPSR and EUDR.
- [E-Invoicing & Audit Automation](https://cheresonanz-design.github.io/opskanon-directory/categories/einvoicing-tax-audit/) (5 tools): XRechnung/ZUGFeRD validation, automated pre-accounting, receipt extraction and FinOps waste audits.
- [B2B Workflow & Lead Ops](https://cheresonanz-design.github.io/opskanon-directory/categories/workflow-lead-ops/) (2 tools): Zero-bloat intake pipelines, RFP/tender response engines, enrichment APIs and static-first micro-tools.
